name: cyrusasha-universalrtl

scripts.test:all: node test/engine.test.js && node test/asar.test.js && node test/patcher.test.js && node test/hook-runtime.test.js && node test/extension.test.js && node test/windows.test.js && node test/launchers.test.js && node scripts/build-browser-extension.js && node test/browser-extension.test.js
scripts.build: node scripts/build-assets.js && node vscode-extension/build-vsix.js && node scripts/build-browser-extension.js && node scripts/build-chrome-crx.js
scripts.lint:firefox: npm run build:browser && npx --yes web-ext lint --source-dir release/browser/firefox-unpacked
scripts.sign:firefox: npm run build:browser && npx --yes web-ext sign --source-dir release/browser/firefox-unpacked --artifacts-dir release/browser/amo-signed --channel=unlisted
